summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Ledgerly Accounting Software MVP. All 41 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified login flow, dashboard, all navigation pages, invoice creation workflow, reports, and logout functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper separation of concerns
All MongoDB _id fields are properly excluded from responses
JWT auth implementation is solid with httpOnly cookies + Bearer token support
Invoice/Bill calculations are correctly computed on backend
Default chart of accounts (18 accounts) properly seeded on startup
seed_data_creation: Backend automatically seeds admin user and 18 default chart of accounts on startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features tested and working: Auth (login/register/logout/me), Contacts CRUD (customers/vendors), Items CRUD, Invoices (create with auto-calculations, send, pay with auto bank txn), Bills (create, pay with negative bank txn), Expenses (create with bank txn), Chart of Accounts (18 seeded + CRUD), Journal Entries (balanced/unbalanced validation), Banking transactions, Dashboard summary with KPIs and charts, Reports (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow). Frontend uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
